name: hr-id-card-automata
description: Progressive Web App to generate HR ID cards from employee data. Local-first, template-driven, exportable to PDF and DOCX. Features a drag-and-drop template designer with layer-based editing, touch controls, rotation support, undo/redo (meaningful changes only), glassmorphism/gradient design tools, toast notifications, multi-template library with Save as New, debounced auto-save, cookie consent, and SEO optimization.
majorCapabilities: Drag-and-drop visual template designer with text, image, shape, and barcode layers
Canvas-based layer editing with snap-to-grid, icon-based resize/rotate handles (larger for touch), and property inspector
Undo/redo history stack (50 steps) — only tracks meaningful changes (skips grab without move)
Gradient backgrounds (linear/radial) for shape layers with color pickers
Glassmorphism effects (blur + opacity) for shape and image layers
Border styles (solid/dashed/dotted) with color pickers for shape and image layers
Touch-enabled controls for drag, resize, and rotate via unified pointer events
Front/back dual-sided template support with side toggle
Responsive canvas with auto-scaling zoom and mobile-friendly layout
Template library with save, load, rename, delete, export/import JSON, and 'Save as New' for multi-template
Debounced auto-save (500ms) to avoid excessive writes during canvas edits
Toast notification system for save, load, import, and export actions
Import templates from image files (PNG/JPG) as tracing backgrounds
GDPR-compliant cookie/localStorage consent banner
Dynamic SEO meta tag injection (Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD)
Full backward compatibility with legacy CardConfig template format
Rotation property in layout panel for element positioning
Dark/light theme with local persistence
Template-driven DataEntry — inputs shown per template text layer variables, image upload only when template has image layers
Template-default-aware employee creation — field defaults extracted from template text context
